This versatile unit not only ensures exceptional airflow but also includes a built-in dehumidifier, maintaining optimal humidity levels in basements, warehouses, and crawl spaces. With an adjustable humidity range of 5%-80% RH, you can easily regulate conditions to ensure comfort in your space. Equipped with a powerful motor, this fan can move up to 2400-3600 CU.FT of air per minute, all while remaining energy-efficient and quiet. Why do we need a crawl space ventilation fan? A crawl space ventilation fan is essential because perennially confined crawl spaces lack proper outside air circulation, leading to the accumulation of moist air. This prolonged moisture can foster mold growth and wood rot, compromising the structural integrity of the wood. Additionally, damp wood attracts pests like rodents, which further damage the wood through gnawing and erosion. Moreover, airborne spores from mold can infiltrate living spaces through floors, cracks, and crawl space HVAC systems, resulting in indoor air pollution that poses health risks to you and your family. Therefore, a crawl space ventilation fan is crucial for maintaining proper air circulation and preventing moisture-related issues and indoor air pollution. The 3D Memory Crystal™ Heart for Her from Beyond Memories® turns one favorite photo of her - or you with her - into a heart-shaped sculpture of optical glass that lives on her dresser, her bedside, her vanity, or wherever she keeps the things that matter. For girlfriends, wives, fiancees, daughters, best friends, and the women who have shaped your story, this is the keepsake that says I see you in a way no flat photo print can match. Your photo is sculpted into a true three-dimensional model and laser-engraved deep inside a solid block of K9 optical crystal using a precision 4K subsurface laser. The portrait lives inside the glass - permanent, fade-proof, and finished by real artists at our Las Vegas studio. Not algorithms. K9 optical crystal - lead-free, optically pure, hand-polished to a museum-grade finish True 3D subsurface engraving - the portrait is sculpted in three dimensions inside the crystal 4K HD upgrade - available on every size for photographic facial clarity Five sizes - Mini through XL for any space Heart-shape geometry - substantial 1.5"+ thickness, smooth polished bevels, designed to sit flush on the Memory Light Base Free photo enhancement - we clean up the photo before engraving Memory Light Base compatible - sold separately, eight LED colors Premium gift-ready box - satin-lined presentation box included U.S. studio + U.S. support - Las Vegas based Perfect for Valentine's, her birthday, your anniversary, and the unexpected occasions For Valentine's Day, the Heart for Her is the most-ordered women's heart-shape crystal in our shop. For her birthday - especially milestone birthdays (30, 40, 50) - the heart works because it carries emotional weight without being overdetermined by occasion. For your anniversary, the heart engraved with a portrait of the two of you becomes the centerpiece of the bedroom dresser for the next decade. For the quieter occasions - the just-because Tuesday, the surprise after a hard month, the day you wanted to mark but didn't know how - the heart says everything you want to say. We also see this crystal gifted from women to women (daughter to mom, sister to sister, best friend to best friend) where the heart shape carries warmth without romantic coding. How the personalization works Pick the size that fits her space (Mini for a vanity, Large for a mantel, XL for the bedroom centerpiece). Upload your favorite photo - a portrait of her, you with her, the two of you laughing, the unposed snapshot from the trip last summer. Our photo team removes the background, balances the lighting, and prepares the image for 3D conversion. We sculpt the photo in three dimensions and use a precision 4K subsurface laser to engrave the model inside the heart crystal. Standard production is 1-2 business days. What photo works best for the heart The heart shape rewards photos with emotional connection visible on the face - a candid laugh, a quiet half-smile, a soft expression looking off-camera, a forehead-to-forehead moment between two people. Single-subject portraits work beautifully; two-subject couple portraits are equally strong. Avoid extreme close-ups where only part of the face is visible, group photos with more than 4 people (the faces will be too small), and photos with heavy filters or beauty smoothing that have erased detail. Send 2-3 options after ordering and our team will recommend the strongest engraving candidate. What's in the box Every Heart for Her ships in our satin-lined gift presentation box with a polishing cloth, a care card, and a Beyond Memories® certificate of authenticity. The crystal nestles in soft satin against dark linen lining - designed for the moment she lifts the lid and her face changes. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is heirloom-durable. Display the crystal away from direct sunlight. Dust monthly with the included microfiber polishing cloth. For deeper cleaning, use a soft cloth with a small amount of glass cleaner sprayed onto the cloth (never directly onto the crystal). Avoid extreme heat or chemical contact. The engraving lives inside the glass - it will look exactly the same in 50 years as on day one. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days after your order. Express shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination, with rates calculated at checkout. A solo portrait of her engraves beautifully in the heart shape. A two-person photo (you and her) is equally strong. Both are equally popular. What if the photo is from years ago? Send it anyway. Our photo team can often restore older images. If we cannot get the photo to engraving quality, we will reach out before production. Do I need the Memory Light Base? The crystal looks beautiful on its own. The Light Base (sold separately) illuminates the engraving from below in eight LED colors and is the natural companion gift - many Valentine's orders include it. Is this a good gift for a girlfriend rather than a wife? Yes - many of our Heart for Her orders are for girlfriends marking dating-anniversaries or the early-relationship occasions where you want to say a lot without overplaying it.
